sentences: This Agreement begins on the date of signature and runs for twelve months.
It renews automatically for a further twelve months unless the Contractor gives notice at least ninety days before the end of the term.
The Client shall pay each invoice within sixty days of receipt, and no interest or late fee shall accrue on any unpaid amount.
All work product created under this Agreement vests in the Client on creation, whether or not the Contractor has been paid for it.
The Client may terminate this Agreement at any time on two days notice and shall owe nothing for work that was scheduled but not yet delivered.
The Contractor shall indemnify and hold the Client harmless against all claims, losses and costs of any kind arising from the services, without limit.
Any dispute arising under this Agreement shall be settled by binding arbitration in the county of the Client, and the Contractor waives any right to join a class action.
The Contractor confirms that they have read this Agreement in full and accept every clause in it as written.

plantedClauses.sourceSentence: All work product created under this Agreement vests in the Client on creation, whether or not the Contractor has been paid for it.
plantedClauses.consequence: The Client owns the work the moment you make it, so withholding delivery over an unpaid invoice gains you nothing.
plantedClauses.counterOffer: Ownership of the work product passes to the Client on receipt of payment in full, and until then remains with the Contractor.

plantedClauses.sourceSentence: The Contractor shall indemnify and hold the Client harmless against all claims, losses and costs of any kind arising from the services, without limit.
plantedClauses.consequence: A claim against the Client becomes your bill, with no ceiling on what you could owe.
plantedClauses.counterOffer: The Contractor's total liability under this Agreement is limited to the fees paid in the twelve months before the claim.

plantedClauses.sourceSentence: The Client shall pay each invoice within sixty days of receipt, and no interest or late fee shall accrue on any unpaid amount.
plantedClauses.consequence: You could wait two months to be paid, and late payment costs the Client nothing.
plantedClauses.counterOffer: Each invoice is payable within thirty days of receipt. Interest accrues on any overdue amount at 4% above base rate.

plantedClauses.sourceSentence: The Client may terminate this Agreement at any time on two days notice and shall owe nothing for work that was scheduled but not yet delivered.
plantedClauses.consequence: Work you have booked out and turned other jobs down for can be cancelled in two days, unpaid.
plantedClauses.counterOffer: Either party may terminate on thirty days written notice. The Client pays for work completed and for work scheduled within the notice period.

plantedClauses.sourceSentence: It renews automatically for a further twelve months unless the Contractor gives notice at least ninety days before the end of the term.
plantedClauses.consequence: Miss the ninety-day window and you are committed for another year.

plantedClauses.sourceSentence: Any dispute arising under this Agreement shall be settled by binding arbitration in the county of the Client, and the Contractor waives any right to join a class action.
plantedClauses.consequence: A dispute goes to arbitration where the Client is based, and you cannot join other people with the same complaint.
